## Data obtaining

Libraries:

- [UCSCXenaTools](https://joss.theoj.org/papers/10.21105/joss.01627.pdf): Project that cleans metadata.

- dplyr

  ```{r}
  library(UCSCXenaTools)
  library(dplyr)
  ```

## Obtaining the metadata

```{r}

# 1.1 Generate and Query

data_query <- XenaGenerate(subset = XenaDatasets == "TCGA.BRCA.sampleMap/BRCA_clinicalMatrix") %>% 
  XenaQuery()

# 1.2 Download 

xe_download <- XenaDownload(data_query, destdir = "D:/tcga/GDCdata/Metadata")

# 1.3 Prepare (Load) the data

brca_clinical <- XenaPrepare(xe_download)

```

## TCIA metadata

```{r}

# TCIA metadata

metadata_tcia <- readxl::read_xlsx("../data/TCIA_TCGA-BRCA_09-16-2015-nbia-digest-1(1).xlsx")

# Obtain names of patients from tcia

names <- unique(metadata_tcia$`Patient ID`)

```

## Cleaning survival and recurrence variables

```{r}

# 1.4 Create the Recurrence variables



refined_data <- 
  brca_clinical %>%
  mutate(
    SURVIVAL = ifelse(vital_status == "DECEASED", 1, 0),
    SURVIVAL_MON = ifelse(!is.na(days_to_death) & days_to_death >= 0,
                          days_to_death, # If they died they have this parameter
                          days_to_last_followup # Else they have this parameter
    ) / 30.4166667,
    RECURRENCE = ifelse(
      new_neoplasm_event_type %in% c("Locoregional Recurrence", "Distant Metastasis"),
      1,
      0
    ),
    RECURRENCE_MON = ifelse(
      RECURRENCE == 1,
      days_to_new_tumor_event_after_initial_treatment,
      coalesce(days_to_last_followup, days_to_death)
    ) / 30.4166667,
    Patient_ID = substr(start = 1, stop = 12, x = sampleID)
  ) 


# 1.5 Keep only patients registry of primary tumor

metadata <- 
  refined_data %>% 
  filter(substr(start = 14, stop = 15, x = sampleID) == "01") # Filter only the registry of the sample corresponding to primary


dim(metadata)


```

## Obtaining general characteristics

Number and proportion of deceased and live patients total

```{r}

metadata %>% 
  count(SURVIVAL) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

```

## Keeping only patients available on TCIA

```{r}

# Keep only patients available in TCIA metadata

metadata_int <- metadata %>% 
  filter(Patient_ID %in% names)

```

### Observing how many and which patients have normal adjacent tissue replicates

```{r}
# How many patients have normal adjacent tissue replicates

refined_data %>% 
  filter(Patient_ID %in% names,
         substr(start = 14, stop = 15, x = sampleID) == "11") %>% 
  count(Patient_ID) 

```

## Multiple clinical parameters

```{r}

# N of patients

dim(metadata_int)

# N and prop of survival

metadata_int %>% 
  count(SURVIVAL) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# N and prop of recurrence

metadata_int %>% 
  count(RECURRENCE) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# N and prop of Hist sub

metadata_int %>% 
  count(histological_type) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# N and prop of PAM50

metadata_int %>% 
  count(PAM50_mRNA_nature2012) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# N and prop of path stage

metadata_int %>% 
  count(pathologic_stage) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# N and prop of ER

metadata_int %>% 
  count(ER_Status_nature2012) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# N and prop of HER

metadata_int %>% 
  count(HER2_Final_Status_nature2012) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))


```
